parameters.name: Available
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to query the virtual IP addresses of only healthy CDN POPs. Valid values:

*   **on**: healthy CDN edge nodes.
*   **off**: all CDN edge nodes.

parameters.name: DomainName
parameters.description: The accelerated domain name. You can specify only one domain name.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cdn describe-user-vips-by-domain --domain-name example.com --available on --region cn-hangzhou
